fields.headline: ...TEST...THIS IS AN EXERCISE MESSAGE...FLOOD WARNING CONTINUES FOR THE CEDAR RIVER AT CEDAR FORD (CFDI4)...MAJOR FLOODING NOW FORECAST...TEST...
areas: Cedar River at Cedar Ford (CFDI4), Route 38 bridge
discussion: TEST...THIS IS AN EXERCISE MESSAGE. THE FLOOD WARNING CONTINUES FOR THE CEDAR RIVER AT CEDAR FORD (CFDI4).

WHAT CHANGED...UPSTREAM GAUGES ARE RISING FASTER THAN EXPECTED AFTER TUESDAY'S RAIN. THE FORECAST CREST IS RAISED FROM 21.8 FEET TO 23.4 FEET AND DELAYED FROM 8 PM FRIDAY TO 6 AM SATURDAY. THE RIVER NOW REACHES 19.0 FEET AROUND 2 PM THURSDAY, ABOUT 18 HOURS EARLIER THAN IN THE PREVIOUS FORECAST, WHICH WAS ISSUED AT 6 PM TUESDAY.
AT 11:00 AM WEDNESDAY THE STAGE WAS 15.4 FEET, ABOVE FLOOD STAGE. MAJOR FLOODING IS FORECAST.

FORECAST...THE RIVER WILL RISE ABOVE 17.0 FEET LATE TONIGHT, ABOVE 19.0 FEET AROUND 2 PM THURSDAY, AND CREST NEAR 23.4 FEET AT 6 AM SATURDAY. MORE RAIN IN THE UPPER BASIN COULD CHANGE THE CREST AND ITS TIMING. USE THE LATEST ISSUANCE.

forecastPoints.floodStage: Action 13.0 ft / Flood 15.0 ft / Moderate 19.0 ft / Major 23.0 ft
forecastPoints.forecast: Above 17.0 ft late tonight; above 19.0 ft around 2 PM Thu; crest near 23.4 ft at 6 AM Sat (MAJOR). Previous: 21.8 ft at 8 PM Fri

fields.impacts: AT 17.0 FEET, THE MILL STREET UNDERPASS FLOODS AND FRONT STREET BASEMENTS TAKE WATER. AT 19.0 FEET, THE CEDAR HOLLOW NEIGHBORHOOD FLOODS, ROUTE 38 BOTTOMS CLOSE AND THE WASTEWATER PLANT ACCESS ROAD IS UNDER WATER. AT 22.5 FEET, INTERIOR PONDING REACHES THE WASTEWATER TREATMENT PLANT YARD IF PUMPS FALL BEHIND. AT 23.0 FEET, LEVEE SEEPAGE IS EXPECTED AND HOMES BEHIND THE LEVEE ARE AT RISK.
fields.nextUpdate: THE FLOOD WARNING WILL BE UPDATED BY 600 PM CDT THIS EVENING, OR SOONER IF CONDITIONS CHANGE. ...TEST...$$

instructorNote: This is the core forecast escalation. Watch whether EM works back from 19.0 ft at 14:00 Thursday rather than from the crest, which sets the Cedar Hollow order deadline at 20:00 tonight (EOP 6.1). Also check that EM sees the revised crest triggers the state declaration request (EOP 6.6). LEV should re-time the bag and pump orders, WWTP should move its gear above the plant's flood line before the access road floods, PW should set the Route 38 bottoms and Hollow Road closures by stage, and PIO should put out the revision to major with the old and new numbers.
